resources.string: Welcome! This app shows a web page and listens to notifications.

string-array.name: device_specific_instructions
string-array.item:
SAMSUNG|1. Tap 'Open App Info' below
2. Tap 'Notifications'
3. Tap 'Allow notifications' to enable
4. You may need to also enable specific notification categories

XIAOMI|1. Tap 'Open App Info' below
2. Tap 'Notifications'
3. Toggle 'Show notifications' to ON
4. You may need to enable notification categories in MIUI settings

HUAWEI|1. Tap 'Open App Info' below
2. Tap 'Notifications'
3. Enable 'Allow notifications'
4. You might need to also check EMUI notification settings

OPPO|1. Tap 'Open App Info' below
2. Tap 'Notifications'
3. Enable 'Allow notifications'
4. Check ColorOS notification settings if needed

VIVO|1. Tap 'Open App Info' below
2. Tap 'Notifications'
3. Toggle notifications ON
4. Check FunTouch OS settings if notifications don't appear

ONEPLUS|1. Tap 'Open App Info' below
2. Tap 'Notifications'
3. Enable 'Show notifications'
4. Check OxygenOS notification settings if needed
